proposition: What Ibn Turka gave Bāysunghur: the R. Suʾl al-Mulūk, a broader overview of lettrism than his other lettrist treatises, with a closing prediction that the Shahrukhid state would last to the end of the 9th century; and readiness to have his work judged before the prince's scholars.

mediation.who: Melvin-Koushki, summarising, dating and identifying the letter(s)

mediation.note: Letters to third parties ask or offer favours; the text survives only in copies made after his lifetime (except the marginal letters in MS Majlis 10196).
